note: Early-career programs and fellowships for a sophomore (Class of 2029) leaning SWE / ML / robotics. Quant and HFT firms excluded. 'verify: true' means the date came from a third-party source; confirm on the official page before relying on it. Refresh this list monthly.

programs.name: Naval Research Enterprise Internship Program (NREIP)
programs.what: Paid 10-week research internship at Navy labs (autonomy, robotics, AI).

programs.name: SMART Scholarship-for-Service
programs.what: Full tuition + stipend + paid summer internships at DoD labs, then a DoD job (service commitment).

programs.name: DOE SULI, Summer 2027
programs.what: Paid 10-week research internship at one of 17 national labs; recommendation letters due by the same date.

programs.name: LLNL Data Science Summer Institute
programs.what: 12-week paid ML/data science research internship.

programs.name: Purdue SURF 2027
programs.what: Paid summer engineering/CS research; travel subsidy for non-Purdue students who meet the priority date.

programs.name: MIT Summer Research Program (MSRP)
programs.what: Fully funded 9-week research at MIT labs (Jun 7 to Aug 7, 2027).

programs.name: CMU Robotics Institute Summer Scholars (RISS)
programs.what: Fully funded summer robotics/AI research in a CMU RI lab, with stipend and housing. Opens Nov 1; last cycle's deadline was Jan 21.

programs.name: NIST SURF 2027
programs.what: Paid 11-week research fellowship at NIST Gaithersburg or Boulder (robotics, AI, CS).

programs.name: Goldwater Scholarship (UT nomination)
programs.what: Up to $7,500/yr research scholarship. Needs a UT Austin campus nomination; the internal deadline is earlier (ask odps@austin.utexas.edu).

programs.name: KP Fellows: Engineering Fellow 2027
programs.what: Paid 12-week Bay Area placement at a KP portfolio startup plus the fellows community. Rolling review, so apply early.

programs.name: Caltech SURF (visiting)
programs.what: 10-week paid research; you line up a Caltech mentor and write a proposal.

programs.name: NASA OSTEM Internships, Summer 2027
programs.what: Paid internships across NASA centers incl. robotics, autonomy and software (NASA STEM Gateway).

programs.name: JPL Summer Internship Program
programs.what: Paid 10-week internship (robotics, autonomy, flight software). JPL recommends applying Oct to Feb.

programs.name: AFRL Scholars
programs.what: Paid summer research at AFRL sites (autonomy, AI, robotics, space). Last cycle closed around Jan 9.

programs.name: Uber Career Prep
programs.what: Mentorship and technical fellowship for first- and second-year CS students; a preferred qualification for Uber SWE internships. Past cycles closed late November.

programs.name: Microsoft Explore (second-year)
programs.what: 12-week SWE/PM internship for underclassmen. The second-year posting closed in October; it may reopen in monthly windows through February.

programs.name: NSF REUs in robotics (JHU CSMR, BYU Robotics Pioneers, Oregon State, USC)
programs.what: Paid 8 to 10-week robotics research REUs; 2027 sites post mid-November to February, with deadlines usually in Feb or March.

programs.name: Z Fellows
programs.what: 1-week builder fellowship with $10k and a demo day. Rolling; students don't need to drop out.

programs.name: Emergent Ventures
programs.what: Fast micro-grants for ambitious projects, including AI and robotics builds. Rolling.

programs.name: Salesforce Futureforce Tech Launchpad (CodePath)
programs.what: Paid 10-week SWE pre-internship for rising juniors. 2027 dates not out yet (last deadline Feb 22); join the CodePath waitlist.

programs.name: Neo Scholars
programs.what: $40k grant + SF summer residency. Closed now; the next round is probably May 2027.

programs.name: NVIDIA Ignite
programs.what: Pre-internship for first and second-years. Closed Oct 18 for 2027.
